gui.banksystem.mod_settings_screen.place: Placeholder identifier. Must start and end with a percent sign to be registered.
Refresh rate of the placeholder in milliseconds.
gui.banksystem.mod_settings_screen.setti: Autosave interval (minutes)
How often the BankSystem data is automatically saved to disk, in minutes.
Balance snapshot interval (minutes)

How often a balance-history snapshot of all accounts is recorded, in minutes.
0 disables snapshots.
Max snapshot records per item (deprecated)
Deprecated as of v2.0.7. The tiered retention model supersedes this flat cap. Value is preserved for compatibility but is no longer applied; set to 0 to silence the boot warning.
Balance snapshot heartbeat (minutes)

Minutes between forced writes when the balance hasn't changed. Ensures the chart can still draw a continuous line for idle accounts.
0 = disable heartbeat (only balance changes are recorded).
History retention sweep (minutes)

How often the tiered downsample+prune sweep runs. Higher = less DB work, larger DB between sweeps.
0 = disable retention (WARNING: unbounded database growth).
Enable info logging
Write INFO messages of the BankSystem mod to the server log.
Enable warning logging
Write WARNING messages of the BankSystem mod to the server log.
Enable error logging
Write ERROR messages of the BankSystem mod to the server log.
Enable debug logging
Write DEBUG messages of the BankSystem mod to the server log.
Starting balance (cents)

Money balance given to new players when their personal bank account is created,
in the smallest money unit (cents: 100 = 1 dollar).
Item transfer interval (ticks)

Interval in game ticks between item-transfer operations of the Bank Terminal
(20 ticks = 1 second).
Additional volatile components

Comma-separated list of item component type ids (e.g. tfc:food) that are ignored
for bank item identity. Extends the datapack tag banksystem:volatile_item_components.
WARNING: changing this can merge distinct bank items — the startup ItemID merge guard
evaluates the change at the next server restart.
Additional deposit-gated components

Comma-separated list of item component type ids that are ignored for bank item identity,
but checked on deposit (blocks laundering item state through the bank).
Extends the datapack tag banksystem:deposit_gated_components.
Evaluated by the startup ItemID merge guard at the next server restart.
Allow all items

Default off. When on, every item that is NOT blacklisted can be banked — the mod's blacklist becomes the sole gate on what can carry a balance.
The blacklist ALWAYS wins: bedrock, barrier, command blocks and all sub-denomination money items remain rejected.
The explicit allow-list stays functional as advisory data — 'Allow Item ID' / 'Remove Item ID' still work but do not gate anything while this flag is on.
Takes effect immediately; no server restart required.
Confirm pending item merge (one-shot)

One-shot confirmation flag for the startup ItemID merge guard.
Set to true ONLY to approve a pending merge reported in the server log;
the merge is applied at the next restart and the flag automatically resets to false.
It can never act as a standing bypass.
Confirm pending world repair (one-shot)

One-shot confirmation flag for the startup ItemID world-repair guard.
Set to true ONLY to approve a pending repair reported in the server log;
the repair is applied at the next restart and the flag automatically resets to false.
It can never act as a standing bypass.
Download block update interval (ticks)

Interval in game ticks between Bank Download Block operations (20 ticks = 1 second).
Applies to blocks on this server; slave servers use their own local settings.json.
Upload block update interval (ticks)

Interval in game ticks between Bank Upload Block operations (20 ticks = 1 second).
Applies to blocks on this server; slave servers use their own local settings.json.
Player balance placeholder

TAB-mod placeholder for the player money balance.
Left: identifier, right: refresh rate in milliseconds.
Requires the TAB mod; registered once at server startup.
Player locked balance placeholder

Requires the TAB mod; registered once at server startup.

Left: identifier, right: refresh rate in milliseconds.
Requires the TAB mod; registered once at server startup.
